title: Without Customers View the log shows the names without links
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Work orders → View' and 'View History Logs' but not 'Customers → View', at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B, whose Bill To was changed from customer A to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Work Order Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The "Bill To changed" entry shows customer A's name and customer B's name.
  • Neither name is a link.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
